about: S4.5 (the owner's plan v3): every route the served app (app.py) answers, and how it is kept to its own customer. tests/test_tenant_isolation_registry.py derives the routes from the app and fails on a route that is missing here, on an identifier parameter that is not declared, and on a gate the endpoint does not call; tests/test_tenant_isolation_pg.py runs every tenant, admin, legacy and demo route with two real accounts on PostgreSQL.

kinds.tenant: takes a customer identifier; another account gets the unknown-id answer (pg matrix)
kinds.admin: names an account, and only the billing admin key may; a customer token gets the unknown-id answer
kinds.legacy_refused: refused in the production configuration (410/501) for every caller
kinds.legacy_ws: a legacy websocket; no deployment exists to authorize
kinds.capability_url: the unguessable link is the access
kinds.account: the caller's own account only; takes no identifier of another customer
kinds.owner: the owner's account only (pricing.m5_founder_account): another signed-in account gets 403, no session 401; takes no identifier
kinds.public: no authentication and no customer data
